name: clockify-mcp
description: Full-coverage Clockify time-tracking server: 117 tools across 18 domains, read-only by default with opt-in writes.
long_description: Exposes Clockify operations as 117 MCP tools across 18 domains: workspaces, users, groups, clients, projects, tasks, tags, time entries, reports (incl. attendance/expense + file export), shared reports, time off, holidays, expenses, approvals, custom fields, scheduling, invoices, and webhooks. Read-only by default; write operations are opt-in via CLOCKIFY_ACCESS_MODE (read | time-tracking | full).

CLOCKIFY_API_KEY.title: Clockify API Key
CLOCKIFY_API_KEY.description: API key used to authenticate against the Clockify API (Profile Settings -> API).

CLOCKIFY_ACCESS_MODE.title: Access Mode
CLOCKIFY_ACCESS_MODE.description: Which write operations are enabled: read (read-only, default), time-tracking, or full.

CLOCKIFY_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID.title: Default Workspace ID
CLOCKIFY_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID.description: Default workspace id used when a tool call omits workspace_id.
